import java.io.*;
import java.util.*;
import java.util.stream.*;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().run();
    }

    private void run() {
        try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
             PrintWriter pw = new PrintWriter(System.out)) {
            
            int n = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
            String input = br.readLine();
            
            String[] parts = input.split("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
            int maxLen = Arrays.stream(parts)
                               .map(s -> Arrays.stream(s.split("_"))
                                               .mapToInt(String::length)
                                               .max()
                                               .orElse(0))
                               .max(Integer::compare)
                               .orElse(0);
            
            long underscoreCount = 0;
            int start = 0;
            while ((start = input.indexOf('(', start)) != -1) {
                int end = input.indexOf(')', start);
                if (end != -1) {
                    String inside = input.substring(start + 1, end);
                    underscoreCount += Arrays.stream(inside.split("_"))
                                            .filter(s -> !s.isEmpty())
                                            .count();
                    start = end + 1;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            
            pw.println(maxLen + " " + underscoreCount);
        } catch (IOException e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
    }
}

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        new Main().execute();
    }

    void execute() {
        try (Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in)) {
            sc.nextLine(); // skip n
            String s = sc.nextLine();
            
            int maxWord = 0;
            String[] outside = s.split("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
            for (String part : outside) {
                String[] words = part.split("_");
                for (String w : words) {
                    maxWord = Math.max(maxWord, w.length());
                }
            }
            
            long underscoreCount = 0;
            Pattern p = Pattern.compile("\\([\\w_]*\\)");
            Matcher m = p.matcher(s);
            while (m.find()) {
                String group = m.group();
                String inner = group.substring(1, group.length() - 1);
                underscoreCount += inner.isEmpty() ? 0 : inner.split("_").length;
                if (!inner.isEmpty() && inner.charAt(inner.length() - 1) == '_') {
                    underscoreCount--;
                }
            }
            
            System.out.println(maxWord + " " + underscoreCount);
        }
    }
}
